title: ECP Registration Manifest (M3-CA1 v1 set-level freeze)
description: The set-level registration freeze document (M3-CA1 v1, 0.6.0, order §11). Built ONLY when the registration-authorization gate is AUTHORIZED (every blocking owner item resolved, every owner-ruling finding ruled, every in-scope case REGISTER, population decision explicit) — the builder REFUSES loudly otherwise, and it never writes the registration ledger: the ledger ceremony remains the separate full-contract instrument binding (evaluation, case version, target system) tuples. The manifest freezes per-case content hashes, qualification artifact hashes, set classes, GT validation tracks, the readiness-run binding (run hash), the population decision, and the immutability rule (changes only through the amendment protocol — two-phase disclosure, full re-review, nothing inherited; ground truth sealed at registration; no post-hoc changes). manifest_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with manifest_hash removed. Real manifest material lives only in a private registration area; public illustrations under examples/ must be format-illustration records with real recomputable hashes.

content_class.description: 'review' = real manifest material (private registration area only); 'format-illustration' = public dummy (examples/ only).

immutability.const: append-only freeze: the manifest may change only through the amendment protocol (two-phase disclosure, full re-review, nothing inherited); ground truth sealed at registration; no post-hoc changes (order §11/§12)

execution_isolation.const: manifest freeze only: NO evaluated model execution; NO case execution; NO results

manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 over ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 of this document with manifest_hash removed.
